story.title: What is love?
paragraphs_en: One day, Farhan learnt the word 'love' in his school and he began to think 'What is love ?How do I love?'

He went to his Abba and asked 'Abbu what is love?' Abba smiled and said 'When you play downstairs and I keep glancing at you to see if you are safe.That is love!' Farhan smiled at his Abba and ran to his Ammi.
Farhan asked his Ammi 'Ammi what is love?' Ammi smiled and said ‘When you share wonderful stories from your school and I listen to them everyday!' Farhan blushed and went looking for his Roshni Aapa.
Farhan asked Roshni ' Aapa, what is love?' Roshni was busy drawing something and felt irritated with Farhan.She said 'Farhan, go away don't disturb me!Farhan felt sad about this.
Farhan then went looking for his beloved Irsu.Farhan looked at Irsu and said to himself ‘If I ask Irsu,he won't be able to tell me what love is!’
Irsu saw Farhan and went running to him.He was so excited to see Farhan that he licked Farhan's face and jumped on him! 'Oh my Irsu! May be this is love?' Farhan exclaimed with joy.

Farhan then went to meet his friend Tejashri and asked her 'Teju do you know what love is?’ Teju narrowed her eyes,scratched her head and said ‘Hmm ,remember when you got 2 chocolates in your class and saved one for me?I think that is love!'

Farhan smiled and said ‘Do you remember Teju, once when I fell down and cried so much, you quickly gave me water and hugged me ? I think that is love too! Teju grinned and said ‘Yes Faru you are right!'
Farhan then happily returned home and saw Roshni sitting in a corner.He ran to her and gave her the Imlis that he had bought from Shanku kaka's shop.
Roshni looked at Farhan and said 'Faru ,I am sorry that I shouted at you,what were you asking me then?'
Farhan said 'Aapa ,I wanted to know what love is and I got the answer!' Roshni's eyes twinkled ,she smiled and said 'Faru ,may be saying sorry like I did is love as well!'
Farhan smiled brightly and hugged Roshni.Today Farhan got to know there are so many meanings of love and so many ways to love! What is your way of loving others?

sentences.text_en: I think that is love too!

sentences.text_vi: Farhan sau đó vui vẻ trở về nhà và thấy Roshni đang ngồi ở một góc. Cậu bé chạy đến chỗ chị và đưa cho chị những quả Imli mà cậu đã mua từ cửa hàng của chú Shanku.

sentences.text_en: Roshni looked at Farhan and said 'Faru ,I am sorry that I shouted at you,what were you asking me then?'
sentences.text_vi: Roshni nhìn Farhan và nói 'Faru, chị xin lỗi vì đã la mắng em, lúc đó em hỏi chị điều gì vậy?'

sentences.text_en: Farhan said 'Aapa ,I wanted to know what love is and I got the answer!' Roshni's eyes twinkled ,she smiled and said 'Faru ,may be saying sorry like I did is love as well!'
sentences.text_vi: Farhan nói 'Chị ơi, em muốn biết yêu là gì và em đã có câu trả lời rồi!' Mắt Roshni lấp lánh, chị ấy mỉm cười và nói 'Faru, có lẽ việc nói xin lỗi như chị vừa làm cũng là yêu đấy!'

sentences.text_en: Farhan smiled brightly and hugged Roshni.Today Farhan got to know there are so many meanings of love and so many ways to love!
sentences.text_vi: Farhan mỉm cười rạng rỡ và ôm Roshni. Hôm nay Farhan đã biết có rất nhiều ý nghĩa của tình yêu và rất nhiều cách để yêu!

sentences.text_en: What is your way of loving others?
sentences.text_vi: Cách yêu thương người khác của bạn là gì?
